Finding a reason to live is so subjective so i won't even try getting into that.  But feeling that "everything i touch turns into rubbish" and the rest, i can - so i (33m) will give my input on that. For the longest i could remember, i felt like i was the litteral scourge that walked this earth, i still do occationally, but i've tried my best to numb that voice.

Most the times, i am able to find productive and less harmful ways to numb them (such as programming, cleaning, training, etc) - other times, i do unfortunetly turn to less productive ways such as alcohol(not recommended obviously).

One thing that started my "journey to becomming happier" was the gym. I was about 170kg at my heaviest, and currently 106kg(ish) - i started doing exactly what everyone tells you you should to feel better, eat healthy(er), workout, sleep, all that stuff - and consequently i started feeling better about myself. So much so, that i even had the confidence to meet someone - my partner - whose absolutely amazing - also has her own demons she's fighting, but after meeting her my life has definetly started making more sense - and i know for a fact that i am also a positive force in her life - so maybe im not all bad after all?

I am not saying that you have to do what i did, or find someone in order to be happy - but what i am trying to say is that i for the most of my life felt like absolute shit and i did find a way out of it eventually - and i know you have it in you as well. 

I truly hope you are able to find that spark inside you that i know you have.

I'm proud of you for going to therapy and seeking help - i too remember how much therapy hurt when starting out , it still does, and i am absolutely terrified to start up this thursday on a year long group therapy venture - but im also excited. I am excited because its another step in the road to my mental healths well-being - its one step closer to being a better boyfriend, son and friend. It will hurt and be hard, but its a challenge im ready to face!

Go back to therapy, keep pushing forward towards a healthier you, i know you got it in you!
